items.headline: Yemen ke paas cargo jahaz par kabza
items.detail: Balhaf se 120 km door samundar me hathiyarbadd log cargo jahaz par chadh gaye aur jahaz par kabza kar liya; UKMTO ne aas-paas ke jahazon ko savdhani bartne ko kaha.
items.exam_angle: Yemen, Gulf of Aden, samudri suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kunar school ke paas dhamaka, 7 chhatra mare
items.detail: Kunar me school ke bagal khanan company ke visfotak bhandar me dhamaka; 7 chhatra mare, 97-99 ghayal. Corrected: pehle 6 maut batayi gayi thi, ab 7 ki pushti hui hai.
items.exam_angle: Afghanistan me suraksha, khanan visfotak — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kim ne parmanu hathiyar badhane ka elan kiya
items.detail: Kim Jong Un ne parmanu samagri wali factory ka daura kar aur hathiyar banane ka elan kiya; America-Dakshin Korea ko khatra bataya.
items.exam_angle: North Korea parmanu karyakram, NPT, Korea Peninsula — UPSC IR

items.headline: Saudi ne Riyadh ki taraf aati missile girayi
items.detail: Saudi hawai raksha ne Houthi ki cruise missile ko Riyadh ke paas giraya; Houthi media ne Sanaa par Saudi hamle ki khabar di.
items.exam_angle: Yemen yuddh, Saudi-Houthi tanaav, West Asia — UPSC IR

items.headline: America ne Iran ja raha jahaz roka
items.detail: America ne Gulf of Oman me Palau-flagged M/V Pacific Archer ke pichle hisse par hamla kar uska propulsion band kar diya; jahaz Iran ke Bandar Abbas se chala tha, crew ko koi nuksan nahi.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanaav, Strait of Hormuz, naval blockade — UPSC IR

items.headline: Italy ne school me burqa par pratibandh lagaya
items.detail: Italy ki sansad ne schoolon me burqa aur niqab par pratibandh aur pehli kaksha me videshi chhatron par 30% ki seema ko manzoori di; paksh me 142 aur virodh me 112 vote pade.
items.exam_angle: Italy, Decreto Scuola, pravasi neeti — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump ne Iraq ke PM ka samarthan kiya
items.detail: Trump ne Iraq ke PM Ali al-Zaidi ke tel taskari rokne aur hathiyaron par rajya ka niyantran laane ke prayas ka samarthan kiya; Iraq ne 2008 se 2025 tak taskari me lagbhag $100 billion khone ka anuman lagaya.
items.exam_angle: Iraq, tel taskari, America-Iraq sambandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Zelensky ne Trump-Putin dosti par sawal uthaye
items.detail: Zelensky ne BBC ko diye interview me Trump ke Putin ko 'dost' kehne ko ajeeb bataya aur kaha Putin 'hamlawar aur hatyara' hai; unhone America se Moscow par zyada dabav dalne ki mang ki.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, America-Ukraine sambandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Canada court ne Bill 21 barkarar rakha
items.detail: Canada ki Supreme Court ne Quebec ke Bill 21 ko lagbhag poori tarah barkarar rakha; sarkari naukriyon me hijab, pagdi jaise dharmik chinh pehenna ab bhi mana hai, sirf vidhayakon ke chehre wale niyam ko hataya gaya.
items.exam_angle: Canada, Bill 21, notwithstanding clause — UPSC IR/Polity

items.headline: Russia ne 1,246 drone giraye, Moscow nishana
items.detail: Russia ne raat bhar me 1,246 Ukrainian drone giraye; 460 se zyada drone Moscow ki taraf aaye, jinme se 123 rajdhani ke paas nasht kiye gaye aur Moscow hawai addon par udanein ruki. Dono taraf ke hamlo me kam se kam 16 log ghayal hue, Zaporizhzhia me 1 ki maut hui.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, drone warfare — UPSC IR

items.headline: Reagan airport par 2 American jets takraye
items.detail: Washington ke Reagan airport par taxi karte hue American Airlines ki 2 Boeing 737 ke pankh takra gaye; koi ghayal nahi, dono viman jaanch ke liye sewa se hataye gaye aur FAA jaanch kar raha hai.
items.exam_angle: America, aviation safety, FAA — UPSC

items.headline: Gaza clinic hamle me 2 MSF karmchari mare
items.detail: Gaza City me MSF clinic par Israeli hamle me 2 chaukidar mare gaye; MSF ne ise seedha hamla bataya, IDF ne dono ko Hamas sadasya batakar hamle ki baat mani.
items.exam_angle: Gaza, MSF, Israel-Hamas yuddhviram — UPSC IR

items.headline: El Nino baadh: Peru-Ecuador me 34 mare
items.detail: El Nino se judi bhari baarish se Peru ke Piura me sadkein doob gayin aur Ecuador me 34 log mare gaye, 47,000 prabhavit hue; dono deshon me apatkal ghoshit hai.
items.exam_angle: El Nino, Peru, Ecuador, baadh — UPSC Geography/Environment

items.headline: Canary Islands naav haadse me 14 mare
items.detail: Spain ke Canary Islands ke paas El Hierro se 72 km door lagbhag 100 logon wali naav se 14 shav mile, 6 log gambhir haalat me aspatal le jaye gaye. Corrected: pehle 8 maut batayi gayi thi, ab 14 ki pushti hui hai.
items.exam_angle: Spain, Canary Islands, pravasi sankat — UPSC IR

items.headline: Sara Duterte ne istife se mana kiya
items.detail: Philippines ki up-rashtrapati Sara Duterte ne istife se mana kar diya aur kaha woh mahabhiyog mukadme ke faisle ke liye taiyar hain; aarop 81.7 crore peso ki bina-hisab sampatti ka hai.
items.exam_angle: Philippines, Sara Duterte, mahabhiyog — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kuwait ne Iran ke rajdoot ko bulaya
items.detail: Kuwait ne drone hamle ke baad Iran ke rajdoot ko bulakar virodh-patra saunpa; hamle me 2 Italian mare gaye the, Iran ne zimmedari se inkar kiya.
items.exam_angle: Kuwait-Iran tanav, Hormuz sankat — UPSC IR

items.headline: Russia ka sabse bada raksha budget
items.detail: Russia ki sansad ne 2027-29 ke liye 50 lakh crore rouble (lagbhag $609 arab) ka raksha budget manzoor kiya, Soviet sangh ke patan ke baad sabse bada; 2027 me raksha par kul kharch ka 35.2% jayega.
items.exam_angle: Russia raksha budget, Soviet ke baad sabse bada — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: Libya ja raha Russian beda wapas muda
items.detail: Ukraine ne 22 November ko Benghazi bandargah me Russian jangi jahaz Merkury ko duboya tha, uske baad Libya ja raha hathiyaron se bhara Russian beda Mediterranean se wapas mud gaya.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine-Russia yuddh Libya tak pahuncha; Africa Corps ke liye hathiyar le ja raha beda wapas muda.

items.headline: Serbia chunav: chhatron ne professor ko chuna
items.detail: Serbia ke chhatra andolan ne 27 December ke rashtrapati chunav ke liye Belgrade University ke chemistry professor Radomir Saicic ko ummidwar banaya.
items.exam_angle: Serbia me chhatra andolan ne October chunav jeeta; 27 December ko rashtrapati chunav.

items.headline: Karachi me imarat giri, 8 mare
items.detail: Karachi me 25 November ko giri chhah manzila imarat ke malbe se 8 shav mile, 10 log abhi lapata hain; 54 ghante baad ek mazdoor zinda nikala gaya.
items.exam_angle: Pakistan me building niyam aur shahari suraksha par sawal; 12 se zyada adhikari nilambit.

items.headline: UK student visa mana, 10 saal ka record
items.detail: Britain me student visa nakarne ki dar 6.4% hui, 2015 ke baad sabse zyada; Bharatiya chhatron ko mile visa 29% gire.
items.exam_angle: UK pravas niti sakht; Bharatiya chhatron par asar.

items.headline: Spain me kal aam chunav, Vox par nazar
items.detail: 29 November ko snap chunav hoga; Sanchez sarkar bachane ki koshish me hain, PP aage hai aur Vox pehli baar rashtriya sarkar me aa sakta hai.
items.exam_angle: Spain, PSOE, PP, Vox — UPSC IR

items.headline: Britain me pravas 1997 ke baad sabse kam
items.detail: ONS ke mutabik June 2026 tak ke saal me net migration 77,000 raha — 2023 ke 9.44 lakh ke record se 90% se zyada ki giravat.
items.exam_angle: UK net migration, ONS — UPSC IR

items.headline: Gaza hamle me Hamas pramukh ka beta bacha
items.detail: Hamas ke mutabik Izzeldeen al-Hayya aur unka parivar subah ke hamle me bach gaye; unke chaar bhai pehle Israeli hamlo me mare ja chuke hain.
items.exam_angle: Gaza, Hamas, Khalil al-Hayya — UPSC IR
